get_current_extract.description: Get what Poland's National Court Register holds today about a company, foundation or association, by its KRS number: name, legal form, NIP, REGON, address, share capital, management board and roles, shareholders or partners, business activities (PKD codes), whether it is in liquidation, bankruptcy or restructuring, debts being enforced, and its latest entry. An entity removed from the register comes back marked removed.

Works for an entity removed from the register too.

description: Look up Polish companies, foundations and associations in Poland's National Court Register (Krajowy Rejestr Sądowy) by KRS number: read the current extract in English (name, legal form, NIP, REGON, address, share capital, management board, shareholders, business activities, and whether it is in liquidation or bankruptcy), the full history of its entries, names, addresses and board members, and which entities changed on a day, and run a workflow when an entity you watch changes. No account or API key required.

krs_entity_changed_trigger.description: Triggers when Poland's National Court Register makes a new entry in the record of the company, foundation or association you watch, such as a new board member, address, share capital, liquidation or its removal from the register, with the new entries and the entity's name and status. Entries made before you turn it on never trigger it

parameters.description: Which part of the register to watch. Leave blank to find the entity in either.
